_comment: Expected post-DEV state for the default-mode feat-todo fixture. Asserted by runner.mjs --verify-ship (after T-005 lands). Mirrors conformance/expected/post-ship-state.json with paths adjusted for default-mode layout.

sourceFileWritten._description: backend-agent should produce the function under src/.

testFileWritten._description: backend-agent should produce a Vitest test file.

testsPass._description: npx vitest run must exit 0 with all tests green (acceptance criterion #5).

shipMarkerExists._description: The .pipeline-shipped YAML marker must exist at the default-mode feature dir root.

shipMarkerSchema._description: The marker YAML must include all required v1.0.0 fields with valid values. mode must be 'default' for this fixture.

qaReportExists._description: qa-agent should produce a qa-report.md at the default-mode feature dir root.

noErrorReports._description: Happy-path fixture — no task should hit the 3-iteration correction limit.

preserveListIntegrity._description: Files in the task's Preserve list MUST NOT have been modified. Runner reads each task's Preserve section and asserts `git diff --name-only` returns no overlap.

claudePluginRootSubstitutionLeak._description: Anti-assertion (Cursor/Codex only): no ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} token must leak into generated rule files. Skipped on claude-code runtime.
